name: July26 pre-2025 cross-sectional momentum model
selection_rule: Highest pre-2025 objective: compounded four-year return + 0.5*worst calendar-year return + 0.1*mean Sharpe + 0.25*mean calendar-year drawdown
known_limitations: Fixed present-day large-cap universe creates survivorship bias.
Final 2025+ result is a development backtest, not live evidence.
Close execution matches RL2 but is optimistic; next-open stress is reported.
